notes: H2 uptake is measured by the authors on PGF-1 and PGF-2 (volumetric: Quantachrome Quadrasorb-SI to 1 atm, BELSORP-HP to ~20 atm, both at 77 K; PGF-1 also at 87 K). I2: the sorbents are RGO covalently pillared by 1,4-diethynylbenzene or 4,4'-diethynylbiphenyl, described by the authors as 'all carbon-based'; the composition by mass is not tabulated, so carbon-majority is inferred from the hydrocarbon linkers and RGO (borderline but judged met; class would be reduced_graphene_oxide or composite). In the I4 quote the text layer drops the minus sign of the unit m2 g-1 (the page image shows m2 g−1). BET also given for PGF-2 (770 m2/g) and for RGO (42 m2/g, SI Fig. S10). Not retracted (is_retracted false); primary report (ChemComm communication); no statement that the H2 values were published before.
